summary: Check-then-act race condition on unique streamVideoId field in PATCH handler
failure_scenario: Two concurrent PATCH requests for different recordings both try to set streamVideoId: 'abc123' → both pass findUnique check → both succeed → duplicate streamVideoId violates DB unique constraint or P2002 error becomes unhandled 500

summary: Missing existence check returns 500 instead of 404 - Prisma update/delete throws P2025 which bubbles to catch
failure_scenario: Teacher clicks delete on already-deleted recording → sees 'Failed to delete recording' (500) instead of 'Recording not found' (404). Affects all 5 new PATCH/DELETE endpoints across recordings, resources, subjects, topics, units

summary: UI passes displayId (derived from email) to PATCH API but API expects database studentId field
failure_scenario: Student created without studentId (nullable in schema) has displayId='001' extracted from email 'student001@lms.local' but API does findUnique({ studentId: '001' }) which won't match null studentId → 404 'Student not found' despite student existing. Works for seeded students but breaks for edge cases

summary: PATCH uses studentId (nullable business key) instead of id (UUID) for lookup, inconsistent with other admin APIs
failure_scenario: Frontend passes displayId which equals studentId for seeded accounts but falls back to email parsing for null studentId. If student has null studentId, API lookup fails with 404. Other admin APIs consistently use UUID id field

summary: requireTeacher() and requireStudent() helpers exist but are unused in all 6 admin API routes and student API routes
failure_scenario: ~48 lines of identical auth boilerplate duplicated across 6 files (12 handlers). Any auth logic change (new role, error format, logging) requires updating all files. Middleware already protects routes but inline checks diverge from centralized pattern

summary: Massive copy-paste CRUD boilerplate across 6 admin API routes (recordings, resources, subjects, topics, units, students)
failure_scenario: Each route reimplements PATCH/DELETE with identical session check, error handling, Prisma patterns (~600 lines total). Bug fixes, audit logging, or auth changes must be applied to 6 files. New admin entity requires copying 100+ lines

summary: Fallback 'Redirecting...' UI doesn't actually redirect - removed useEffect with router.push, relies entirely on middleware
failure_scenario: Middleware misses a path (e.g., new route not in matcher) OR client-side navigation bypasses middleware → user sees 'Redirecting...' indefinitely with no actual navigation. Page becomes stuck. Same issue in dashboard/layout.tsx:74
Frontend sends action: 'Enable' (capitalized) → API returns 400 'valid action (enable/disable) are required' despite valid intent. Frontend currently sends lowercase but API contract is brittle

summary: Client-side O(n³) transformation on every render - 4 sorts, 2 filters, nested maps for progress calculation
failure_scenario: Student with 10 subjects × 10 units × 20 topics = 2000 topics → 60,000+ iterations per render. Jank on mobile; blocks main thread. Should move aggregation to server or use RSC

summary: Over-fetching in dashboard API - returns entire curriculum tree (all subjects/units/topics/resources/recordings/quizzes/progress) with no pagination or field selection
failure_scenario: 50 subjects × 10 units × 15 topics = 7500 topics × 3 nested arrays → ~2MB JSON per request. Slow TTFB, high memory, bandwidth waste for mobile users. No ?subjectId= filter or select to prune unused relations
